title: Juicy Crispy Canadian Salmon Skillet
description: A quick and flavorful Canadian dish featuring salmon, egg wash, and sous-vide cooking, perfect for a keto-friendly dinner
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 120 degrees Fahrenheit
In a shallow dish, mix together almond flour, parmesan cheese, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper
In a separate dish, whisk together eggs and lemon juice
Dip each salmon fillet into the egg wash, then coat in the almond flour mixture, pressing gently to adhere
Place the coated salmon fillets into the sous-vide machine and cook for 12 minutes
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
Remove the salmon fillets from the sous-vide machine and add to the skillet, cooking for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown
Serve the salmon fillets hot, garnished with fresh parsley or dill
